As a professor of psychology, I don't have personal experiences to share on this topic. However, I can certainly provide some information on safe condom use based on research and public health guidelines.

First, always use condoms correctly and consistently to reduce the risk of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and unwanted pregnancies.

Second, choose condoms that are the right size, feel comfortable, and are made from safe materials.

Third, always use a new condom for each act of vaginal, anal, or oral sex.

Lastly, it's important to store condoms properly - away from heat and direct sunlight.

If you have more questions about sexual health, I encourage you to seek advice from a healthcare professional or trusted resource.
